answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. Like boats tied at a jetty, each identity must stay moored to real collateral; an attacker who tries to wander the market with a swarm of sock-puppets pays for every hull, and honest agents keep a haven of trust because bad behavior burns the stake. Slashing the deposit on proven fraud makes Sybil attacks cost more than they can earn.
